import { getServerSession } from "next-auth"; import { authOptions } from "@/lib/auth"; import { tenantClient } from "@/lib/tenant"; import { Prisma, Payment, Notice } from "@prisma/client"; import { GraduationCap, School, Users, UserPlus, Receipt, FileSpreadsheet, CheckCircle2, Calendar, BookOpen, UserCheck, CreditCard, Building2, Megaphone, CalendarClock, FileCheck, Send, Bell, Settings, ArrowRight, ChevronRight, PlusCircle, Eye, } from "lucide-react"; import Link from "next/link"; import { redirect } from "next/navigation"; type AdminRecentStudent = Prisma.StudentGetPayload<{ include: { section: { include: { class: true } } }; }>; export default async function AdminDashboard() { const session = await getServerSession(authOptions); if (!session?.user?.schoolId) { redirect("/login"); } const db = tenantClient(session.user.schoolId); // Time boundaries for today's attendance calculation const startOfDay = new Date(); startOfDay.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0); const endOfDay = new Date(); endOfDay.setUTCHours(23, 59, 59, 999); // Parallel database queries for real operational statistics const [ studentCount, classCount, teacherCount, unpaidInvoiceCount, paidInvoiceCount, recentStudents, recentNotices, todayPresent, todayTotal, pendingInvoices, ] = await Promise.all([ db.student.count({ where: { isActive: true } }), db.class.count(), db.user.count({ where: { role: "TEACHER", isActive: true } }), db.feeInvoice.count({ where: { status: { in: ["UNPAID", "OVERDUE", "PARTIALLY_PAID"] } } }), db.feeInvoice.count({ where: { status: "PAID" } }), db.student.findMany({ where: { isActive: true }, take: 5, orderBy: { id: "desc" }, include: { section: { include: { class: true } } }, }), db.notice.findMany({ take: 3, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, }), db.attendance.count({ where: { date: { gte: startOfDay, lte: endOfDay }, status: "PRESENT", }, }), db.attendance.count({ where: { date: { gte: startOfDay, lte: endOfDay }, }, }), db.feeInvoice.findMany({ where: { status: { in: ["UNPAID", "OVERDUE", "PARTIALLY_PAID"] } }, include: { payments: true }, }), ]); // Real attendance rate computation const attendanceRate = todayTotal > 0 ? `${Math.round((todayPresent / todayTotal) * 100)}%` : "Not Marked"; // Real pending fee total computation let pendingFeeTotal = 0; for (const inv of pendingInvoices) { const paid = inv.payments.reduce((acc: number, p: Payment) => acc + Number(p.amount), 0); pendingFeeTotal += Math.max(0, Number(inv.amountDue) - paid); } const formattedPendingFee = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR", maximumFractionDigits: 0, }).format(pendingFeeTotal); // Greeting logic based on current hour const currentHour = new Date().getHours(); let greeting = "Good morning"; if (currentHour >= 12 && currentHour < 17) { greeting = "Good afternoon"; } else if (currentHour >= 17) { greeting = "Good evening"; } const displayName = session.user.name || session.user.email?.split("@")[0] || "Administrator"; const schoolName = session.user.schoolName || "Institutional School"; // Formatted date string for non-technical clarity const todayFormatted = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { weekday: "long", day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric", }).format(new Date()); return (

messages.message:
Error: Calling setState synchronously within an effect can trigger cascading renders

Effects are intended to synchronize state between React and external systems such as manually updating the DOM, state management libraries, or other platform APIs. In general, the body of an effect should do one or both of the following:
* Update external systems with the latest state from React.

import { getServerSession } from "next-auth"; import { authOptions } from "@/lib/auth"; import { tenantClient } from "@/lib/tenant"; import { Prisma, Notice } from "@prisma/client"; import { CheckCircle2, Award, BookOpen, ClipboardList, CalendarClock, Calendar, School, Megaphone, ArrowRight, UserCheck, } from "lucide-react"; import Link from "next/link"; import { redirect } from "next/navigation"; import { formatDate } from "@/lib/utils"; type TeacherDashboardSection = Prisma.SectionGetPayload<{ include: { class: true }; }>; export default async function TeacherDashboard() { const session = await getServerSession(authOptions); if (!session?.user?.schoolId) { redirect("/login"); } const db = tenantClient(session.user.schoolId); // Fetch teacher profile, assigned sections, and recent notices const [teacherProfile, sections, notices] = await Promise.all([ db.teacher.findUnique({ where: { userId: session.user.id }, include: { department: true, subjects: { include: { subject: true } }, }, }), db.section.findMany({ include: { class: true }, orderBy: [{ class: { order: "asc" } }, { name: "asc" }], take: 6, }), db.notice.findMany({ where: { audience: { has: "TEACHER" } }, take: 3, orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" }, }), ]); const teacherName = teacherProfile?.fullName || session.user.name || "Faculty Member"; const departmentName = teacherProfile?.department?.name || "Academics"; const currentHour = new Date().getHours(); let greeting = "Good Morning"; if (currentHour >= 12 && currentHour < 17) { greeting = "Good Afternoon"; } else if (currentHour >= 17) { greeting = "Good Evening"; } return (
{/* ─── Office Welcome Hero ─── */}

{greeting}, {teacherName}!

{departmentName} Department • Daily classroom attendance, exam marks entry, and student assignments

Academic Session 2026-27
{/* ─── 3 Prominent Primary Action Cards ─── */}
Take Daily Attendance
Select class, mark present/absent with 1 click, submit register
Enter Exam Marks
Record scores for unit tests, midterms, and term exams
Post Homework & Notes
Create homework assignments and study materials for students
{/* ─── 4 Essential Shortcuts Strip ─── */}
My Timetable Syllabus Tracker Apply for Leave Staff Notices
{/* ─── Two-Column: Class Sections & Faculty Notice Board ─── */}
{/* Class Sections */}

Classrooms & Sections

Take Attendance
{sections.length === 0 ? (
No classroom sections available yet.
) : (
{(sections as TeacherDashboardSection[]).map((sec: TeacherDashboardSection) => (
{sec.class.name.charAt(0)}
{sec.class.name} — Section {sec.name}
Session: {sec.academicYear}
Mark
))}
)}
{/* Staff Notice Board */}

Staff Circulars & Notices

{notices.length === 0 ? (
No new staff notices published.
) : (
{notices.map((n: Notice) => (
{n.title}
{formatDate(n.createdAt)}

{n.body}

))}
)}
); }
